result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals on all legs. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distances and faded pavement markings suggest a need for safety enhancements to better protect pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings in the foreground are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without a median refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the zebra markings with high-durability, reflective paint to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by vehicles parked directly on the sidewalk, which completely obstructs the walkway and creates significant sightline issues at the intersection. Although a marked crosswalk exists, the lack of curb ramps and the poor condition of the pavement further hinder safe and accessible movement.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: Multiple vehicles are parked directly on the sidewalk area, completely blocking the pedestrian path and forcing people into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the corner

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk and corner area show significant cracking and uneven surfaces, creating trip hazards.

interventions.title: Install Bollards
interventions.description: Place physical bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from driving onto and parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps and repair the sidewalk surface to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide roadway with continuous sidewalks but lacks essential safety infrastructure like marked crosswalks or curb ramps. High crossing distances and sightline obstructions from parked cars create a moderately hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence at the visible intersection area.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a long time in the path of vehicles without any refuge or narrowing of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including a broad sidewalk, marked crosswalks, and traffic signals with pedestrian indicators. However, the crossing distance across the multi-lane roadway is significant, and the pavement condition shows signs of wear and debris.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center-right

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement and Debris
hazards.description: Cracks in the sidewalk and debris near the curb edge create minor trip hazards and indicate poor maintenance.
